product.amstrad-integra-p75.summary: The entry Pentium in the British Integra catalogue, between the Premier 486 and Power Pro.
product.amstrad-integra-p75.history: Amstrad Direct offered the Premier P75 for £1,149 plus VAT in its 1996 British brochure. It kept the Premier applications and games bundle and occupied the middle of the home range.
product.amstrad-integra-p75.technical.co: The remote control operated the built-in television. The brochure lists Fastext, a 540 MB EIDE drive and a 4× CD-ROM drive. The MPEG card was optional.
product.amstrad-integra-p75.technical.ve: The configuration has been checked against contemporary sources. The BluMach sheet is in research.
product.amstrad-integra-p75.technical.li: An attributable system BIOS, motherboard identification and validation of boot, TV tuner and remote control remain pending.
product.amstrad-integra-p75.technical.re: The recovery package restores multimedia functions in Windows 95. The preserved Integra Pentium package contains TV and MPEG software.
product.amstrad-integra-p75.technical.br: Amstrad Direct · Integra PC/TV brochure · pp. 2–4
